name: capell-app/socials
description: Keep one list of social profiles per site and show follow or share links on pages with the Socials block, without network scripts.
agent_tools_reason: Socials only renders profile links and share links that open the visitor's chosen network; it has no action or data an agent could run or read on the page.

healthChecks.label: Socials storage tables and frontend widget renderer are available

marketplace.summary: One list of social profiles per site, and a block that shows plain follow or share links.
marketplace.description: Store each site's social profiles once and place them with a block. Editors choose follow or share mode, label style, alignment and link target. Eleven built-in networks and custom links are covered, with a live preview in the admin and icons drawn inline.
marketplace.problem: Social links are hard-coded in several places and out of step.
marketplace.outcome: One list per site drives the follow and share links on any page.

faq.question: Do the links load anything from the social networks?
faq.answer: No. Visitors see small icons, text labels or both, drawn as plain links that load no scripts from the networks, and a click takes them to the network.

faq.question: What must happen before editors can use it?
faq.answer: A developer runs the install command once on the server. It sets up the storage for your lists and also runs every other pending database update.

faq.question: Which networks are built in?
faq.answer: Eleven, including X, Facebook and LinkedIn, and a custom link covers anything else. Handles and addresses are checked against the network.

faq.question: Can an editor limited to one site change another site's list?
faq.answer: No. People limited to certain sites can edit only those sites' lists, and each site has one list.
